analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI slightly increased from 60.9 to 62.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram is holding at -9.8910 without improvement. Volume at 1.14x the 5-day average indicates no significant momentum. While the 52-week position at 27.4% is still low, the price is entering resistance zones at the 5-day high of $2,532.96 and the swing resistance of $2,423.04, suggesting potential for a pullback rather than further gains. Confirmation of support at SMA20 ($2,299.44) and swing support ($2,387.61) is needed.
